_note: The border-free area. The one real difference from the EU in this roster is CHE, which is in Schengen and was never in the EU -- GBR is in neither. Ships zero-priced for the reason eurozone.json gives: an open-borders effect (a trade bonus is the obvious candidate) is a measured band or nothing, and nothing is what is measured so far.
name: Schengen
summary: The countries with no internal border controls. People, lorries and holiday traffic cross the lines without stopping.
